SELECT SUM(state_total) AS total_invoice_amount, AVG(state_invoice_count) AS average_invoices_per_state
FROM (
  SELECT c.State, SUM(i.Total) AS state_total, COUNT(*) AS state_invoice_count
  FROM Invoice i
  JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
  WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2010-06-22 00:00:00'
    AND i.InvoiceDate <= '2012-06-26 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY c.State
) AS state_totals;
